title: Make My Photo Reel Fun
tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The sampled frames show plain full-screen photos without visible humorous overlays or other clearly playful styling; bouncy motion or lively transitions cannot be verified from these stills.
The mountain-lake image looks noticeably soft when enlarged to fill the vertical frame.

judge.summary: An eight-second vertical photo montage is delivered, but its playful treatment and inclusion of the beach-friends photo cannot be confirmed from the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
must_haves.why: One MP4 is reported as eight seconds long, and its sampled frames are vertical.

must_haves.item: All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
must_haves.why: The retriever, shocked cat, curly-haired woman and mountain lake appear in the supplied output frames. The beach friends are not shown in these samples but could appear between them.

must_haves.item: The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
must_haves.why: No playful overlays or styling are visible. The sparse still samples do not establish whether playful motion, timing or transitions occur.

must_haves.item: Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
must_haves.why: The dog, cat and woman's faces are clear and unobscured in the sampled frames, but the friends and the entirety of each appearance cannot be inspected.

must_haves.item: The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: The output is one MP4 showing different full-screen photographs at successive timestamps.
